annotations.title: BLS wage percentiles by job and city

description: Return real BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics annual wages — 10th, 25th, median, 75th and 90th percentile — for an occupation, optionally narrowed to a metro or state, alongside the metro's cost-of-living index. Use this to answer 'what does a nurse earn in Chicago' or 'am I underpaid' with sourced figures.
